sources.snippet: Despite large language models (LLMs) being known to exhibit bias against non-mainstream varieties, there are no known labeled datasets for sentiment analysis across English varieties. To address this gap, we introduce BESSTIE, a benchmark for sentiment and sarcasm classification for three varieties of English: Australian (en-AU), Indian (en-IN), and British (en-UK). sources.snippet: By highlighting gaps in the model performance, especially for (a) sarcasm classification in general; and (b) outer-circle varieties like en-IN for both the tasks, this benchmark will be useful to evaluate dialectal biases of language models, and contribute to research towards equitable performance across all varieties of English.
